name: Root
summary: Root module containing repository configuration, build tooling, and vitest workspace setup for a monorepo with packages for chord, telemetry, ai, agent, protocol, client, server, coding-agent, and tui.
keyPoints: Monorepo root with at least 9 packages under `packages/` (chord, telemetry, ai, agent, protocol, client, server, coding-agent, tui), configured via vitest workspace paths.
Contains tooling configs: biome.json (lint/format), tsconfig.base.json (shared TypeScript), vitest.base.ts (test setup), plus package.json/.npmrc for dependency management.
Includes cross-platform test scripts: mini-test.sh, pi-test.bat (Windows batch), pi-test.ps1 (PowerShell), pi-test.sh (shell), and test.sh — indicating multi-OS CI/test support.
tui-plan.md suggests design planning for the TUI (terminal UI) package, which has a dedicated tsconfig.kaioken.json for the Kaioken framework.
AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, LICENSE, README.md present — standard community/contribution docs.
vitest.base.ts exports `workspaceSourcePaths` — a const mapping package entry points (e.g., chordIndex, aiIndex, tuiIndex) to absolute file URLs, used for targeted test runs.

entryPoints.name: workspaceSourcePaths
entryPoints.note: Const object mapping each package's source entry path (like chordIndex) to its absolute file URL via import.meta.url, used by vitest workspace config.
